rubrics.justification: Accurately describes an expanded/full blastocyst with thinned zona, B-grade ICM, and good TE consistent with 3BA/4BA; appropriately notes limits of single-image review. Minor issue is questioning the reported stage without direct image confirmation.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrium, prior cycle history, and lifestyle with embryo quality to frame prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with conclusions and probability estimates clearly tied to embryo morphology and favorable patient factors while acknowledging uncertainty.
Recommendations are strongly aligned with IVF best practice: single embryo transfer in a young good-prognosis patient, avoidance of unsupported add-ons, and no routine PGT-A indication at age 27.
Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer and contingency planning after failed attempts. Useful and specific, though some steps remain general rather than protocol-level.
